subject: Shiny Server : Error getting worker: Error: listen EADDRNOTAVAIL

messages.author: 5c06b65d148916e5
messages.subject: Shiny Server : Error getting worker: Error: listen EADDRNOTAVAIL
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to run Shiny Server on a VM that runs on a private cloud.

I successfully installed Shiny Server and  configured it to listen on port 80
# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"
run_as shiny;

# Define a server that listens on port 80
server {
  listen 80;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /srv/shiny-server;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;

  }

}
 
As you can see here ( http://genocloud.genouest.org/cloud/37/ )I have access to the Shiny index.html page, but there is an error when starting the apps (even the example app). 

In the shiny-server.log, I've got the following info message : 

[2015-01-21 10:06:11.070] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: listen EADDRNOTAVAIL


I think it's a problem with network configuration and nodejs but I don't know what exactly and how Shiny app deployment works.

Any suggestions ?

PS : OS is Ubuntu

messages.author: 5c06b65d148916e5
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server : Error getting worker: Error: listen EADDRNOTAVAIL
parts:
I eventually found the solution. 

The loopback was not defined on the VM, so the node.js servers running the apps were not able to start on 127.0.0.1.

Thanks for your help.
